随着这一声让人无比心酸，又惨绝人寰的喊叫声响起，无数在树上休息的飞鸟受惊的往远处飞去，发出一阵阵‘啾啾’的叫声，而造事者却是充耳不闻，完全沉浸于自己的悲剧之中。
这是一个有着黑色短发与黑色瞳孔的少年，少年大概有着二十岁左右的年龄，长着一张虽然不是大众脸，但也算不上帅气的脸庞，此时，他正蹲伏在一片森林的空地上，低垂着头，一脸的悲伤。
抬起头来，看了看周围那些一眼望不到顶的树木，少年欲哭无泪。
谁能想到，一觉睡醒过来，自己居然来到了这么一个人不人鬼不鬼的地方，当然，这是少年自己认为的，至少在外人看来，这里至少还算是一片充满朝气的森林。
少年也不是没有想过，自己是在做梦当中，不过，从他的手臂上那仍然‘新鲜’的淤青中可以看出，现实是残酷的！这是经过证实的！
“难道这就是传说中的穿越？可是为什么木有外挂，为什么木有重生，而是在这个人影都不见一个的鬼地方，这要叫我怎么办啊？我不认识路的，各位穿越大神，你们难道是在逼我便当吗？”一把瘫坐在空地上，也不理那一地的砂土，少年嘴巴一张一合，不断的碎碎念着什么。
该说真不愧是一宅系少年吗？
或许是那少年口中不知道存不存在的穿越大神也被他念烦了吧，在少年还在自哀自怨的时候，一个机械一般冷漠又古井无波的声音响了起来。
“系统启动中…启动成功！尊敬的使用者，系统向您问好…”
当一个人呆在一个不见半点人影的地方，突然响起一个低沉冷漠的声音时，会是怎么样的反应呢？此时，少年的表现，可以告诉你。
只见他浑身一抖，怪叫一声从地上一跃而起，那跳跃力，已经是足够用来破了他终生的跳跃记录了，就算是在少年还没变成废宅的时候，也没有如此矫健的身手。
“谁…谁…别装神弄鬼的，你以为我会怕你吗？告诉你，就算是真的要领便当，哥们我也要选择在看完七天七夜的动漫之后再自己饿死，绝对不会死在这不明不白的地方，懂？”少年一边颤抖，一边哈哈大笑的说道，声音说不出来的弱气。
“……”现场顿时陷入一片寂静当中，少年缩了缩自己的头，不断的东张西望，完全不知道自己到底说了怎样雷人的话。
或许是有点自觉了吧，（你确定？）少年咽了一口口水，强忍着拔腿离开的冲动，断断续续的说道：“那个…你…你倒是说句话…”
其实也不能怪他，任谁遇到这样的情况，都无法镇定下来吧？更何况少年只是一个普通的家里蹲，完全不出门的那种。
可惜，茂盛的森林里，仍然是一片寂静，仿佛刚才的那个声音，只是一个幻觉一般。
心虚的看了一眼四周，少年深呼吸了一口气，让自己快速跳动的心脏缓缓的减慢速度，然后才开口说道：“喂，那个自称系统的家伙……”
一开口，少年就自己愣住了。
系统？好像刚才是这么说的吧？绝对没有听错！传说中的穿越系统？金手指？

不会是真的吧？…
想到这里，少年反而是冷静了下来，挠了挠自己的头发，少年疑惑的叫了一声。“系统？…”
话音刚一落下，机械一般的声音便再次响起。“愿意为您服务，使用者！”
少年的心脏再次一跳，不过有了些许心理准备之后，少年也不再像刚才一样神经质了，这样的情景，只要是一个宅，就能够想到大概发生了什么样的事情了。
“那个…系统，这里是哪里？到底发生了什么事？我为什么会在这里呢？”犹如机关枪一样发射着自己的口水，少年迫不及待的想要知道自己到底处于什么样的状况下，在这个毫无人迹的森林里，少年只能把这所谓的系统当成自己的救命稻草了。
“滴！当前使用者位置：斯巴利尔世界，巨兽森林！”
斯巴利尔世界？巨兽森林？
好吧，从这些信息之内，少年得出了以下几个结论：一，自己穿越了；二，从那些地方名中可以看出，他是穿越到一个有点类似于西方风格的世界里；三，如果这里只是一个普通的世界，那或许还好一点，而如果是玄幻魔幻类型的世界的话，从那个巨兽森林的坑爹名字中可以看出，自己领便当的几率大概只比女生自己送上门来的几率小上那么一点…

As this extremely sad and cruel cry rang out, countless birds resting on the trees flew away in fright, making bursts of 'chirp' sounds, but the perpetrator turned a deaf ear and was completely immersed in his own tragedy.
This is a boy with short black hair and black pupils. The boy is about twenty years old. Although he has a face that is not popular, it is not handsome either. At this time, he is crouching in the clearing of a forest, with his head lowered and a look of sadness on his face.
Raising his head and looking at the trees around him that could not be reached at a glance, the young man felt like crying without tears.
Who would have thought that when he woke up, he would come to such a place where there were no humans or ghosts. Of course, this was what the young man thought. At least in the eyes of outsiders, this place was at least a forest full of vitality.
It was not that the boy had never thought that he was in a dream, but from the still 'fresh' bruises on his arms, it could be seen that reality was cruel! This is proven!
"Is this the legendary time travel? But why is there no plug-in, why is there no rebirth, but in this ghost place where no one can be seen? What should I do? I don't know the road, all the time travel masters, are you forcing me to eat?" Sitting on the open ground, ignoring the sand on the ground, the young man opened and closed his mouth, constantly muttering something.
Should I say that he really deserves to be a nerdy boy?
Maybe he was tired of thinking about the time-travel god that the young man said existed. While the young man was still feeling sorry for himself, a mechanical, indifferent and unruffled voice spoke.
"The system is starting...started successfully! Dear user, the system greets you..."
How would a person react when a low, indifferent voice suddenly rang out when he was in a place where no one was around? At this time, I can tell you the boy's performance.
He trembled all over and jumped up from the ground with a strange cry. The jumping power was enough to break his lifelong jumping record. Even before the boy became a waste, he did not have such strong skills.
"Who... who... don't pretend to be crazy, do you think I will be afraid of you? Tell you, even if I really want to receive a lunch, buddy, I will choose to starve to death after watching the anime of Seven Days and Seven Nights. I will never die in this unknown place, understand?" The young man said with a trembling laugh and a weak voice that could not be expressed.
"..." The scene suddenly fell into silence. The young man shrank his head and kept looking around, having no idea what kind of shocking words he had said.
Maybe he was a little self-conscious, (are you sure?) The young man swallowed a mouthful of saliva, resisted the urge to leave, and said intermittently: "Well...you...you should say something..."
In fact, you can't blame him. No one can calm down in such a situation, right? What's more, the boy is just an ordinary guy who stays at home and doesn't go out at all.
Unfortunately, there was still silence in the lush forest, as if the sound just now was just an illusion.
Glancing around guiltily, the young man took a deep breath, letting his rapidly beating heart slowly slow down, and then said: "Hey, that guy who calls himself System..."
As soon as he spoke, the young man was stunned.
system? It seems like that’s what you said just now, right? You definitely heard that right! The legendary time travel system? Goldfinger?
Can't it be true? …
Thinking of this, the young man calmed down and scratched his hair. The young man yelped in confusion. "system?…”
As soon as he finished speaking, a mechanical voice sounded again. "Ready to serve you, user! "
The young man's heart beat again, but after being mentally prepared, the young man was no longer as nervous as before. In such a situation, any otaku would be able to imagine what happened.
"That... system, where is this? What happened? Why am I here? " Shooting his saliva like a machine gun, the boy couldn't wait to know what kind of situation he was in. In this uninhabited forest, the boy could only regard this so-called system as his own life-saving straw.
“Dip! Current user location: Sparir World, Behemoth Forest! "
Sparir world? Monster forest?
Well, from this information, the boy came to the following conclusions: First, he has traveled through time; second, from the place names, it can be seen that he has traveled to a world that is somewhat similar to the Western style; third, if this is just an ordinary world, it might be better, but if it is a fantasy world, it can be seen from the cheating name of the giant beast forest that the chance of receiving lunch by himself is probably only a little smaller than the chance of a girl delivering it to his door...
